sections.Profile:
Big Valley , released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in May 1970, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Ted Zale with artwork by Christian Marche. The game is notable for being one of the first four-player machines to feature multiball, adding a unique layer of challenge and excitement.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1970
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Western, Original Theme, 1970s, Animals
